payload.title: FrickSharingService stateful sharing layer
payload.description:
## Frick today
Raw verbs only — createInvitation / acceptInvitation / listGrants / revokeGrant on FrickClient, plus FrickSharingPermission / FrickInvitation / FrickGrant value types (FrickSharing.swift). No stateful layer.

## What RangerCRM built (port source of truth)
/Users/bri/dev/RangerCRM/RangerCRM/Model/RangerData/Services/FrickSharingService.swift (~275 LOC): an observable grant cache, the accept/revoke orchestration on top of the raw verbs, and deep-link parsing. Generic except the literal "rangercrm" URL scheme.

Also related: SharingPermissions.swift (~192 LOC) — permission-gating logic is generic; the NSManagedObject -> Frick recordType mapping stays app-side.

## What the port gives us
The stateful sharing layer (the UICloudSharingController-equivalent for Frick) becomes reusable, with the URL scheme as injected config rather than a hardcoded literal. Self-contained ~260 generic lines; medium value, low coupling.

## Downstream impact
RangerCRM keeps only the recordType mapping + its scheme constant; the cache/orchestration/deep-link parsing come from FrickSwift.
